name: Primo Golf founders (Gay and Williamson cousins) and Grant Horvat
note: Primo Golf Apparel is owned by its four founders, cousins Matty Gay, Jason Williamson, Jordan Williamson and Kirk Williamson, with YouTube golfer Grant Horvat, who became the first owner outside the founding family in March 2024 (DORMIED, 2026-07-20). Lehi, Utah company.
